source.title: WMT Leader Announcement (March 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader, Saransh Grover. He will become the new Leader of the WCA Marketing Team (WMT) and was already working as a Member of the Team.
<!-- break -->
Saransh was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Somya Srivastava for the work she has done for the WMT, and wish Saransh best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

Xia Yan

We thank Xia for applying and both applications can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IZkEwon7t-WGqSJTS7iLTuM2Riil7qEs?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组负责人任命公告（2021 年 3 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，WCA 市场营销组（WMT）成员 Saransh Grover 将出任团队新负责人。

根据[《WCA 委员会与团队动议》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定了 Saransh，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Somya Srivastava 为 WMT 所做的工作，祝 Saransh 在新岗位上工作顺利。

董事会还收到了以下申请者的材料：

* Xia Yan

感谢 Xia 提交申请。两份申请材料均可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IZkEwon7t-WGqSJTS7iLTuM2Riil7qEs?usp=sharing)查看。
